embedded_text:
BANT COACH · SETUP GUIDE

HOW TO SET IT UP

FOUR STEPS
This skill needs your script to grade against, so you add it before you upload. That's the
only extra step.
UNZIP THE FILE

1

Click the download button in your email to save bant-coach.zip. Double-click it. You get a folder called
bant-coach with two files: SKILL.md (the coach) and script.md (where your script goes).
TIP

On a Mac, Safari may unzip it for you. If you already see a bant-coach folder in Downloads, skip to step 2.

PASTE IN YOUR SCRIPT

2

Open script.md. Delete everything inside it, paste your sales script, and save. Keep the file name
script.md. If your script is in Google Docs, go to File → Download → Markdown (.md) and copy that in.
TIP

Keep your section headers (Intro, Disco, Qualify, Close). The fixes point to them. Setters and closers on

different scripts? Paste both, each under its own header.

ZIP IT BACK UP

3

Right-click the bant-coach folder and compress it. This new zip has your script inside, so it's the one you
upload. On a Mac it may be named bant-coach 2.zip.

UPLOAD IT TO CLAUDE

4

In Claude, go to Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill and pick the new zip. Open the skill and you'll
see both files: SKILL.md and script.md.
TIP

Changed your script? Repeat steps 2 to 4 and choose replace when you upload.

WATCH IT DONE · 3-MINUTE WALKTHROUGH

▶

Watch the setup video on YouTube
youtube.com/watch?v=uSUSRoXOuFQ

BANT COACH · SETUP GUIDE

OPTIONAL · 2 MINUTES

MAKE IT YOURS
The more it knows about your business, the more accurate it gets. Open the skill, click
Edit, and find Your Business. Write your answer after each colon, delete the e.g.
examples, and save.

What you sell

Roof replacements · 12-week fitness coaching · Payroll software

Who you sell to

Homeowners 50+ · Busy moms · Business owners doing $1M+

Rep roles

Setters book calls, closers sell · One rep runs the whole sale

Budget

$250k+ revenue and $50k+ profit · Can pay $5k upfront · Financing approved

Authority

Owner on the call · Owns the home, both spouses on the call

Need

A specific goal plus something stopping them

Timing

Start within 30 days · This quarter

Leave a line blank and it uses the bar written in your script. If neither has one, it uses a simple default.

NO SCRIPT YET?

WRITE ONE QUESTION PER LETTER
Delete everything in script.md and write the one question your reps ask for each letter. Then zip and upload
as normal.
Budget

"Most people invest around $X for this. Does that work for you?"

Authority

"Who else would be part of this decision?"

Need

"What's stopping you from getting there on your own?"

Timing

"When do you want this solved by?"

BANT COACH · SETUP GUIDE

ONCE IT'S RUNNING

PASTE A CALL. GET THE TAPE.
Start a new chat, paste a call transcript, and say "Run BANT Coach on this call." Here's
what comes back.
EXAMPLE OUTPUT

SETTER · B2B

Call: Setter · outbound · booked
Decision: Shouldn't have moved forward
BANT: ✗ Budget · ✓ Authority · ~ Need · ✓ Timing
Fixes:
1. Need (weak), start here: Took "need more clients" and moved on. → Go one level deeper: an example and
what it costs them. Script: Disco → Pain
2. Budget (failed): Booked after "can't spend anything till spring." → Don't move forward below the bar. Script:
Qualify → Budget
Drill: Manager plays an owner who only wants more clients. Rep asks for an example and the cost.

HOW TO READ THE MARKS

✓ Strong. Met the bar, or

~ Weak. Asked, but the

✗ Failed. They clearly

? Never came up on the

a concern was raised

answer was vague.

don't meet the bar.

call.

and solved.

The goal is a check on every letter and no fixes. When there are fixes, start with the one marked start here and
run the drill in your next team huddle.

USE CHATGPT OR A CLAUDE PROJECT?

Paste SKILL.md in as the instructions and upload script.md as a file. It works the same way.
